profile.headline: 🪣/🪓 Staff Software Engineer at Okta
profile.summary:
I am a Staff Software Engineer at Warner Bros. Discovery with experience in agile methodologies working in the Release and Delivery Engineering organization. As an expert in GitHub Actions, I helped design the CI/CD workflows used to build and deploy the backend services including initial creation and expansion over time. I have professional experience with Golang, Python, and Java, as well as cloud native technologies like Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm. When working in cloud spaces, I primarily have experience with AWS and automation using Terraform.

My passion is ensuring that developers have the tools they need to do their work in an automated fashion, ideally self-service, and have them be secure by default, because when security is easy and seamless, it will be chosen every time.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Discovery, I worked on internal tooling and build systems for Discovery+. Following the merger into Warner Bros. Discovery, I joined the Release and Delivery Engineering organization as a tech lead focused on enabling engineers across the company to move faster and ship more confidently, allowing us to release Max (now HBO Max) in under 1 year.

- Built self-service tooling for onboarding users, teams, and repositories to GitHub at scale, ensuring required corporate settings and security files are applied automatically.
- Designed and expanded reusable GitHub Actions workflows used to build, test, and deploy all Max backend services, including a feature flag system for controlled rollouts and easy rollbacks.
- Migrated Max backend services from JFrog Artifactory to AWS ECR, then reworked regional image management, resulting in ~$45,000/month in savings.
- Led migration from SonarCloud to SonarQube, moving ~3,500 projects across ~10 GitHub organizations in under 2 months.
- Partnered with application security to surface container image scan results directly in pull request comments, making vulnerabilities actionable at the point of development.
- Officially mentored 3 junior engineers, all of whom have since been promoted at least one level.
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Sonarqube · Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kubernetes · Go · DevOps · Containerization · Terraform

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
At F5 Networks I was part of a DevOps focused platform team, building and operating the internal developer tooling and infrastructure used by product development teams across the organization.

- Architected and operated a GitLab CI/CD platform handling over 100,000 jobs/week, owning reliability and scaling as adoption grew across the organization.
- Leveraged Helm and Cluster API to build automation enabling developers to self-serve Kubernetes clusters for dev/test, and production cluster deployments for the infrastructure team.
- Created custom integrations between internal tools, including ServiceNow and Artifactory to automate repository creation and reduce manual toil for teams.
- Discovered and responsibly disclosed CVE-2019-10205, a vulnerability in Red Hat Quay that stored robot account tokens in plain text.
- Spoke at GitLab Commit San Francisco on best practices for GitLab Runners in Kubernetes.
- Ran internal office hours and helped coordinate hackathons to grow DevOps adoption across engineering.
positions.insights: Skills: DevOps · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Go · Artifactory · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
At CA Technologies I worked on CA Performance Management, focused on the data collection layer and the certification system that defines how devices are polled for metrics.

- Reworked the device certification system to allow customers to override how metrics are collected and calculated, giving teams flexibility beyond the stock configuration.
- Maintained and extended the InstallAnywhere-based installer used to install and upgrade the product.
- Built and installed a physical build status light visible to the entire office, reducing the time broken builds went unnoticed.

positions.title: PC Service Manager
positions.description: Manage the day to day operations of PC service, making sure that service gets done in a timely manner, and create solutions to increase productivity.  I also maintain an appointment system for the company while adding new features as necessary.

projects.title: GitHub Actions Monitoring
projects.description: A Go service that monitors hundreds of GitHub Actions for supply-chain attacks, detecting SHA drift on pinned semver tags, analyzing new tag releases, and scanning diffs for indicators of compromise across 21+ attack patterns (credential exfiltration, registry tampering, reverse shells, and more). It persists snapshots in PostgreSQL and sends Discord alerts on suspicious findings, and includes an agentic investigation pipeline powered by Claude that performs structured risk assessments and generates incident write-ups for confirmed compromises. The application is deployed as a minimal scratch-based Docker image on Kubernetes.

projects.title: Drift
projects.description:
Drift is a desktop application for automated video transcoding, built as my first exploration into agentic software development using AI-assisted coding tools.

Drift monitors a directory for incoming video files and automatically queues them for encoding via HandBrakeCLI, with support for up to 8 parallel sessions, custom HandBrake presets, crash recovery with automatic re-queuing, and a system tray mode for background operation. Built with Electron, React, and TypeScript.

Beyond the app itself, this project was an experiment in using AI agents to drive development; learning where it thrives, focusing on broader goals and niche edge cases while letting the agents handle the bulk of the implementation.
